problemRelevance.UP-605: X16 layers form a controlled, weaker domain-shift test of the state-overlap condition required before transferring a process twin across tools or fabs; no semiconductor-fab performance claim is made.
problemRelevance.UP-315: The X16 ledger is a bounded counterexample to the assumption that several finite synchronized channels necessarily identify one system history; it is not a universal impossibility theorem.

confirmedFacts: The public X16 manifest includes DAQ archives but no MotionBLITZ .dat or .exp file, camera tick ledger, or trigger-to-frame sidecar. Manifest absence does not prove that no laboratory-held copy exists.

X16 DAQ files sample galvo X encoder, galvo Y encoder, LTZ lens encoder, and laser-power reference at 100 kHz. They measure actual motion and power with calibration uncertainty but do not contain camera exposure identity.
The official XYPT_L001-025.zip object is 159,164,372 bytes, matches its official SHA-256, and contains 25 authenticated CSV members.
L0001 has 94,736 camera-trigger rows; all camera-trigger rows have positive commanded power.
No candidate in L0002-L0025 passes all nine preregistered gates.
L0013 and L0025 are byte-identical and tie for lowest score, yet fail trigger count, direction, and local correspondence.
L0008/L0020, L0010/L0022, L0012/L0024, and L0013/L0025 are four byte-identical member pairs.
After a documented cell-boundary clarification, Node and Python agree on every hash, gate, rank, and numeric result within 3.20e-13.
inferences: The first 25 layers do not contain a frame-correspondable command twin of L0001 under the sealed definition.
A small global geometry or power distance cannot compensate for mismatched count, direction, or local ordinal structure.
Downloading a candidate AVI as though it were an L0001 framewise control is not justified by these commands.
Within-layer synthetic deletion can still test a detector without requiring different layers to correspond frame by frame.
unverifiedProposals: Replace whole-layer twins with state-supported self-deletion calibration across disjoint development and confirmatory layers.
Use XYPT plus calibrated DAQ encoder and power states to define transfer support, while treating thermal history and optical drift as explicit nuisance variables.
Report natural L0001 locations only for strata with preregistered holdout error bounds; retain intervals or an unknown label elsewhere.

hypotheses.T2_globalSimilarityWithoutFullLocalCorre: not observed under every aggregate gate; several close layers still fail count or direction before the local gate

failedAttempt.description: The first independent runs disagreed only in seven spatial Hellinger values because binary floating-point values on grid boundaries were assigned to opposite cells.
failedAttempt.resolution: Amendment 05 fixed a symmetric 1e-12 integer-boundary snap and required a complete rerun; it did not change any threshold or candidate.

uncertainty.measurement: XYPT is command data. DAQ adds calibrated actual motion and power but not frame identity or exact shutter-open time.
uncertainty.model: The strict ordinal and proper-rotation gate can reject a nonlinear physical similarity, deliberately prioritizing false-transfer control.
uncertainty.sampling: The negative search covers layers 2 through 25, not all 250 X16 layers.
uncertainty.externalValidity: Even a command pass would not prove image exchangeability because interlayer temperature, powder state, geometry, and optics can change.
uncertainty.implementation: Independent agreement detects implementation faults but both implementations share the same mathematical specification and source archive.
